page.overview:
Who is Raphael Splinterson?

Raphael Splinterson is one of the main protagonists of the 2003 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles TV series. He is the strongest of the team who uses his twin sai, other weapons, mastery of Ninjutsu to protect New York City from threats such as the Shredder. On top of being the strongest, he is the most temperamental and hostile, but his deep love for his family is what has him fighting the hardest.

Raphael is represented by the color red, most prominently reflected by his red traditional bandana. His skin tone is a deep emerald green, the darkest of the Turtles. He wears the same brown knee/shoulder pads and belt as his brothers. His weapon of choice is twin sai, which he carries in his belt.

For the last two seasons of the show, due to the differing animation styles in Fast Forward and Back to the Sewer, Raphael suddenly appears taller than his brothers with a slightly lightened skin tone.

Raphael is a typical brash, street smart, no-nonsense, and headstrong New Yorker with a accent. His personality can be best summed up by the theme song from season 4 onward in which it's stated that you can always "count on Raphael to throw the first punch". His personality is similar to that of his original —he is aggressive and headstrong. However, he is slightly more sarcastic and moody. Despite being impulsive, he has better control over his anger. When it's too much though, he is still prone to bursts blind rage.
